dogecoin.text:

3:04 AM

half-asleep

Twitter was quiet

My brain whispered:
"Bro... this coin’s got a frog in a cowboy hat. It's definitely the next $DOGE."

@grok @elonmusk Decoding alien signals in Dogecoin charts? Now that’s next-level crypto! Grok’s math is sharp, but @elonmusk — ready to confirm extraterrestrial endorsements or drop a zany plot twist?” 🛸🚀🐕‍🦺
